name: Run Turn
source:
Main heroine of "Tail Tale",a KemoLoli (female furry cub) maiden living in Zarpat. [spoiler]Her father is from Bastalk.[/spoiler] Run's tail is wrapped by a long roll of ribbon.

(Taken from Wikifur)
